title: Global revision coverage and non-Docker GC acceptance
scope: SQL and file atomic retirement batches; shared-path and HTTPS file consumers; explicit SQL downstream federation; provider GC and fenced unknown disposition

boundaries.file_registry: single and atomic batch retirement under shared catalog flock; committed proof index and required anchor protect late admission; explicit retired-payload cleanup; old writers must be drained
boundaries.sql_registry: same-catalog SQLite/PostgreSQL atomic retirement; explicit enrolled downstream federation installs permanent guards and collects all durable acknowledgements before central retirement; partial downstream retirement is not rolled back
boundaries.cache_batch: one exact private host file per apply
boundaries.revision_batch: preview limit 1..128; file committed proof index or SQL transaction provides atomic local retirement; policy and references are rechecked
boundaries.faults: coordinator process crashes and journal loss refuse replay; canonical single-use claim survives all host-local evidence loss; explicit whole-VM fencing and fresh signed observation dispose unknown libvirt/Firecracker GC without inventing success
boundaries.unenrolled_registry: unregistered repositories are outside federation; they cannot be treated as empty consumers or receive deletion guarantees

not_closed: full API/Agent SIGKILL matrix and provider-internal partial calls
final same-commit combined stage-2 strict acceptance
evidence_rule: all selected strict gates must pass on the same source digest and commit; failure/skip/missing environment does not close scope; original requirement remaining items stay open
